# #797: constant-export design file checked

`benchmark/challenges/constant-export-design.md` exists on this branch. I did not rewrite it and made no Edit. I did not re-run the probe or read score.py.

## Verdicts (from #791, not re-measured)
- Empty export: DETECTED on library-icon-tests and library-specialty. All dimensions are `missing` (score.py:203-204).
- Constant export: DETECTED on the same two fixtures. All dimensions are `incorrect` (score.py:207-208).
- vi-actor-core-native-gap: NOT-APPLICABLE for both probes. Its controls have no claims, so it stays `unsupported` (score.py:199-200).

## Unmeasured
A constant equal to a keyed literal is not measured. The design file proposes a `constant-keyed-literal-export` control for it. The control still needs to be built and reviewed.

## Checks
- `git status --porcelain` returned empty output. No existing file other than the design file changed.
- A stray `benchmark/scripts/__pycache__/score.cpython-314.pyc` existed (from #791's probe run, probably). The first verification run failed on the `__pycache__` assertion. I deleted the file, and the directory no longer exists. `docs/research/poc/__pycache__/inspect_vi.cpython-312.pyc` also exists. It is outside the benchmark scope, so I left it. It did not appear in `git status`.
- Verification after the cleanup printed `design OK`.

No LabVIEW behaviour is claimed. Benchmark readiness stays false.

## Discoveries
- The #791 probe left bytecode in `benchmark/scripts/__pycache__`. Future probes should run with `python3 -B`.
